method: Fresh isolated processes; same request trace; rotating variant order; two passes. First reader pass is not a cold-disk measurement. OS file cache uncontrolled. NUP C++ Eglantine source recompiled unchanged; NX original from Git HEAD. Stdio compared with stdio; mapping compared with mapping. Windows peak resident and private-commit memory include executable, metadata and scratch. Source file mapped pages are included in resident memory but not private commitment. Spill bytes are live temporary-file bytes at end of reads. Service throughput sums timed reads and excludes CSV output, full-byte comparisons and open/mount. Private request paths are not for publication.
hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D; Windows 11 26200; MSVC 19.51 /O2; static Zstd 1.5.8
